question: The base radius of a circular cylinder is 10.5 cm. If the area of its curved surface is 792 cm², then what is the volume of the cylinder?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The Volume and Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder are directly related.

Since Volume = πr²h and CSA = 2πrh, we can substitute CSA into the volume formula.

Volume = (CSA ÷ 2) × r

Volume = (792 ÷ 2) × 10.5

Volume = 396 × 10.5 = 4158 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 4158 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of base (r) = 10.5 cm

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 792 cm²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10e023b2992b6c02a368c70008a4890599b279122cc49ccb0e12b3023d34037b.png] 

**Formula Used:**

CSA of cylinder = 2πrh

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 10.5 × h = 792

⇒ 2 × 22 × 1.5 × h = 792

⇒ 66 × h = 792

⇒ h = 792 ÷ 66 = 12 cm

Now, substitute the value of height (h) to calculate the volume:

⇒ Volume = πr²h

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × 10.5 × 10.5 × 12

⇒ Volume = 22 × 1.5 × 10.5 × 12

⇒ Volume = 33 × 126

⇒ Volume = 4158 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 4158 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the two circular flat bases: TSA = 2πr(r + h).

Volume of a Cone vs Cylinder

A cone with the same base radius and height has exactly one-third the volume of the corresponding cylinder: V = (1 ÷ 3)πr²h.

Hollow Cylinder

For a hollow cylinder with outer radius R and inner radius r, the volume of the material used is given by V = π(R² − r²)h.
